Start with day and night, then explore Moon phases, seasons and the clocks we use around the world.

By Biel Sardà · Published 30 Sept 2026 · Suggest a correction

From the basics · 4 lessons · No timer

What you’ll explore

You do not need a telescope or any astronomy lessons to begin. A ball beside a lamp, the changing evening light and a call to a faraway friend will help us make sense of the sky and our clocks.

A few words worth knowing

Phase
One of the different views we get of the Moon’s bright side.
Hemisphere
One half of Earth.
Time zone
An area that follows the same rules for its clocks.
